title: Stay Sharp: - Double-Check: Look up Facts You Think You
description: To stay sharp: - Double-check: Look up facts you think you "just know." - Ask questions: Challenge statements that feel familiar but unverified. - Don’t repeat unverified info: Sharing it reinforces the bias. Example: Before you repeat a fun “fact” you read online, spend 5 minutes confirming it.
